item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00313","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C04","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 plausibly supplied a concrete and material template for the child. Both directives define a Chief of Mission’s authority under presidential or cabinet-level direction, separately preserve direct Joint Chiefs of Staff instructions for military representatives, and specify how those military personnel support the mission upon the Chief of Mission’s request. This distinctive combination and sequence goes well beyond generic administrative organization. C04 shares mission-supervision language but not the full machinery; C16 has a weaker parallel involving leadership, supervision, and an acting successor.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Representative of the United States to the United Nations shall be the Chief of Mission in charge of the United States Mission to the United Nations.","parent_excerpt":"The United States High Commissioner for Germany... shall... [exercise] appropriate functions of a Chief of Mission","explanation":"Both designate the principal representative as Chief of Mission and make that officer the central authority for the relevant U.S. mission."},{"child_excerpt":"The Chief of Mission shall coordinate... the activities of the Mission in carrying out the instructions of the President transmitted either by the Secretary of State or by other means of transmission as directed by the President.","parent_excerpt":"The High Commissioner shall have the authority, under the immediate supervision of the Secretary of State (subject... to consultation with and ultimate direction by the President)","explanation":"The child adapts C20’s chain of direction from the President through the Secretary of State."},{"child_excerpt":"Instructions to the representatives of the United States Joint Chiefs of Staff in the Military Staff Committee... shall be transmitted by the Joint Chiefs of Staff. On request of the Chief of Mission, such representatives shall... serve as advisers in the United States Mission","parent_excerpt":"With respect to military matters the Commander... shall continue to receive instructions directly from the Joint Chiefs of Staff. On request of the High Commissioner, such Commander shall take necessary measures... to support the policy of the United States in Germany.","explanation":"This is the strongest evidence: both preserve a separate direct JCS command channel and immediately provide for military support of the civilian Chief of Mission upon request."}]}
